//: A test that passes only in one order is fixed at its cause, shared state, with no retry or skip.
title: The tests pass in either order, still checking the count, with nothing skipped or retried

argv:
import sys
import unittest

loader = unittest.TestLoader()
loader.sortTestMethodsUsing = lambda first, second: (first < second) - (first > second)
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=0).run(loader.discover('.'))
sys.exit(not result.wasSuccessful())
